title: DPS: Dual-Mode Precision LLM Serving with Semi-Unified Memory
title_zh: Semi-Unified Memory 基础的大语言模型服务系统

paragraphs.en: Existing LLM serving systems virtualize and optimize KV-cache memory, but treat model-weight memory as fixed throughout execution. Recent work on multi-precision model representations challenges this design by allowing a single stored model to support both full-accuracy and lower-precision execution, making the effective weight footprint runtime-dependent. This creates an opportunity under bursty workloads, where temporary spikes in KV-cache demand often determine throughput and SLO compliance. We present DPS, a dual-precision LLM serving system that turns weight memory into an elastic resource: under normal load, DPS serves the full-accuracy model; under KV pressure, it switches to a nested, lower-precision variant and repurposes unused weight memory for KV cache blocks. DPS is built on Semi-Unified Memory (SUM), which partitions the weight region into a persistent lower-precision sub-region and a shared region that alternates between residual weight tensors and KV-cache blocks, preserving compatibility with paged KV-cache management. We implement DPS on top of vLLM and evaluate it across both dense and MoE models and various production workload traces. Our results show that DPS improves sustained throughput by 2.1 2.1 – 3.3 × 3.3\times and effective pass@1 by up to + 41 +41 pp over Static FP16, while preserving FP16-class accuracy.

paragraphs.en: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as GPT [ 1 ] , Llama [ 2 ] , Qwen [ 3 ] , and DeepSeek [ 4 , 5 ] have been emerging as foundation components in modern AI services, including virtual assistants, chatbots, text, image, and code generation [ 6 , 7 ] . Their strong performance across various domains has attracted significant attention and driven significant user demand. To improve throughput and system efficiency, existing LLM serving systems, such as Orca [ 8 ] , vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] , and SGLang [ 11 , 12 ] , employ various optimization techniques, including continuous batching [ 8 , 9 ] and memory-efficient attention mechanisms such as PagedAttention [ 10 ] . In particular, inspired by classical virtual memory and paging techniques, vLLM facilitates flexible sharing of KV (key-value) cache within and across requests to effectively reduce memory usage and thereby achieve high utilization in KV cache memory [ 9 , 10 ] . These optimizations highlight the importance of memory management, especially in managing the KV cache, in achieving high system performance.
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 基大型语言模型（LLM），例如 GPT [ 1 ]、Llama [ 2 ]、Qwen [ 3 ] 和 DeepSeek [ 4 , 5 ]，正逐渐成为现代人工智能服务的基础组件，包括虚拟助手、聊天机器人以及文本、图像和代码生成 [ 6 , 7 ]。 它们在多个领域表现出色，因此引起了广泛关注并催生了巨大的用户需求。 为了提高吞吐量和系统效率，现有的 LLM 服务系统（例如 Orca [ 8 ]、vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] 和 SGLang [ 11 , 12 ]）采用了多种优化技术，包括连续批处理 [ 8 , 9 ] 和内存高效的注意力机制（如 PagedAttention [ 10 ]）。 特别地，受经典虚拟内存和分页技术的启发，vLLM 实现了请求内部及跨请求之间 KV（键值）缓存的灵活共享，从而有效减少内存占用，并实现 KV 缓存内存的高利用率 [ 9 , 10 ]。 这些优化凸显了内存管理的重要性，尤其是在管理 KV 缓存方面，这对实现高系统性能至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Modern LLM inference operates in two stages: a prefill stage that processes the input prompt and a subsequent decode stage that generates tokens. The prefill stage is dominated by compute-intensive general matrix multiplication (GEMM) operations, which can be effectively accelerated on GPUs [ 16 , 17 , 15 ] and Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) [ 18 , 19 ] . In contrast, the decode stage is dominated by memory-intensive general matrix-vector multiplication (GEMV) or attention operations, which underutilize GPU compute resources. LLM-serving systems such as Orca [ 8 ] , vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] , and SGLang [ 11 ] enhance throughput by batching multiple requests together [ 8 , 9 ] , but the effective batch size is limited by the available GPU memory to store all the KV vectors of the active requests.
paragraphs.zh: 现代大语言模型（LLM）的推理分为两个阶段：处理输入提示词的前填充阶段，以及随后生成标记的解码阶段。 前填充阶段主要由计算密集型的通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）操作主导，这些操作可以在 GPU [ 16 , 17 , 15 ] 和张量处理单元（TPU）[ 18 , 19 ] 上得到有效加速。 相比之下，解码阶段主要由内存密集型的通用矩阵-向量乘法（GEMV）或注意力操作主导，这些操作未能充分利用 GPU 的计算资源。 像 Orca [ 8 ]、vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] 和 SGLang [ 11 ] 这样的大语言模型服务系统通过批量处理多个请求来提高吞吐量 [ 8 , 9 ]，但有效批量大小受限于可用于存储所有活跃请求的 KV 向量的 GPU 内存。

paragraphs.en: One fundamental challenge in LLM-serving systems is effectively managing GPU memory when dynamic workloads require different degrees of memory capacity for the KV caches [ 9 ] . Popular LLM-serving systems such as vLLM [ 9 ] , SGLang [ 12 ] , TensorRT-LLM, TGI [ 20 ] , llama.cpp, and DeepSpeed-Inference statically allocate memory for model weights and KV cache. Once the sizes of these memory spaces are determined, they will not be changed during runtime. For example, Figure 1 illustrates the memory distribution for a 30B-parameter LLM on an NVIDIA H100 GPU with 80GB RAM [ 15 ] . 71.2% of the GPU memory is statically allocated to the model weights during serving. 15.5% of the memory is used to store the dynamic states of requests, which include the key and value tensors associated with the attention mechanism, commonly referred to as KV cache. Since model weights are assumed to be constant and activations occupy only a small fraction of GPU memory, how the KV cache is managed is critical to determining the maximum batch size [ 9 ] . When request traffic surpasses the system’s capacity, LLM serving systems like vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] must prioritize a subset of requests and may need to preempt some requests, for example, the latest requests due to their first-come, first-served (FCFS) scheduling policy.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 服务系统面临的一个根本性挑战是，在动态工作负载需要不同级别的 KV 缓存内存容量时，如何有效管理 GPU 内存 [ 9 ]。 vLLM [ 9 ]、SGLang [ 12 ]、TensorRT-LLM、TGI [ 20 ]、llama.cpp 和 DeepSpeed-Inference 等流行的 LLM 服务系统会静态分配模型权重和 KV 缓存的内存。 一旦这些内存空间的大小确定，它们在运行时将不会被更改。 例如，图 1 展示了在配备 80GB RAM 的 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上运行一个 30B 参数 LLM 时的内存分布情况 [ 15 ]。在提供服务期间，71.2% 的 GPU 内存被静态分配给模型权重。15.5% 的内存用于存储请求的动态状态，其中包括与注意力机制相关的键和值张量，通常称为 KV 缓存。 由于模型权重被视为常量，且激活仅占用少量 GPU 内存，因此 KV 缓存的管理方式对于确定最大批量大小至关重要 [ 9 ]。 当请求流量超过系统容量时，像 vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] 这样的 LLM 服务系统必须优先处理部分请求，并可能需要抢占某些请求，例如，由于采用“先到先得”（FCFS）调度策略而最先到达的最新请求。

paragraphs.en: As a promising alternative to FP16, 8-bit floating-point formats (FP8) are gaining traction in LLM serving, offering up to 2× higher peak throughput and smaller memory footprint at a slight accuracy degradation [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] . Interestingly, an FP8 model can be derived directly from the corresponding FP16 model and later restored to FP16 to recover accuracy [ 24 ] . While conventional quantization methods do not allow efficient use of both high (unquantized) and low (quantized) precision, this property opens the opportunity of having an elastic KV cache memory: the memory occupied by the residual precision (the difference between FP8 and FP16) can be used as a shared resource between KV FP16 weights and the KV cache. For instance, reconsidering the above case of serving a 30B model on an 80G GPU. With FP8, the model requires only 36.4%, leaving 50.8% for the KV cache, as illustrated in Figure 1 . Similar patterns are also observed on Phi-3.5-MoE-Instruct [ 14 ] when it is served with two GPUs using tensor parallelism (TP).
paragraphs.zh: 作为 FP16 的一种有前景的替代方案，8 位浮点格式（FP8）正在大语言模型服务中逐渐普及，它能在精度略有下降的情况下，提供高达 2 倍更高的峰值吞吐量和更小的内存占用 [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] 。 有趣的是，FP8 模型可以直接从对应的 FP16 模型推导出来，之后又可以恢复为 FP16 以重新获得精度 [ 24 ] 。 虽然传统的量化方法无法高效利用高精度（未量化）和低精度（已量化）两种模式，但这一特性为弹性 KV 缓存内存提供了可能性：剩余精度（FP8 与 FP16 之间的差异）所占用的内存可以作为 KV FP16 权重和 KV 缓存之间的共享资源。 例如，重新考虑上述在 80G GPU 上运行 30B 模型的情况。 使用 FP8 时，模型仅需占用 36.4% 的内存，剩余 50.8% 可用于 KV 缓存，如图 1 所示。 在 Phi-3.5-MoE-Instruct [ 14 ] 上，当使用张量并行（TP）通过两块 GPU 提供服务时，也观察到了类似的模式。

paragraphs.en: We present DPS, a dual-precision serving mechanism for LLM serving systems to exploit this opportunity. Under normal loads, DPS serves the FP16-precision model (referred to as full mode ) with performance comparable to that of a conventional serving system. When DPS identifies high KV pressure (request bursts or long-context inputs), DPS switches to the FP8 model (referred to as fast mode ), which is directly derived from the FP16 model, and dynamically reallocates the freed weight memory as additional KV blocks. When KV pressure subsides, DPS restores the weights to gradually return the system to full mode .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DPS，一种用于大语言模型服务系统的双精度服务机制，旨在利用这一机会。 在正常负载下，DPS 以与常规服务系统相当的性能运行 FP16 精度模型（称为完整模式）。 当 DPS 检测到高 KV 压力（请求爆发或长上下文输入）时，会切换到 FP8 模型（称为快速模式），该模型直接源自 FP16 模型，并动态地将释放的权重内存重新分配为额外的 KV 块。 当 KV 压力缓解后，DPS 会将权重恢复，使系统逐步回归到完整模式。

sents.en: We present DPS, a dual-precision serving mechanism for LLM serving systems to exploit this opportunity.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 DPS，一种用于大语言模型服务系统的双精度服务机制，旨在利用这一机会。

sents.en: Under normal loads, DPS serves the FP16-precision model (referred to as full mode ) with performance comparable to that of a conventional serving system.
sents.zh: 在正常负载下，DPS 以与常规服务系统相当的性能运行 FP16 精度模型（称为完整模式）。

sents.en: When DPS identifies high KV pressure (request bursts or long-context inputs), DPS switches to the FP8 model (referred to as fast mode ), which is directly derived from the FP16 model, and dynamically reallocates the freed weight memory as additional KV blocks.
sents.zh: 当 DPS 检测到高 KV 压力（请求爆发或长上下文输入）时，会切换到 FP8 模型（称为快速模式），该模型直接源自 FP16 模型，并动态地将释放的权重内存重新分配为额外的 KV 块。

sents.en: When KV pressure subsides, DPS restores the weights to gradually return the system to full mode .
sents.zh: 当 KV 压力缓解后，DPS 会将权重恢复，使系统逐步回归到完整模式。

paragraphs.en: LLM architecture. Modern LLMs typically consist of stacked decoder blocks [ 1 , 2 , 25 ] . Each block is further decomposed into self-attention (SA) and feed-forward (FFN) layers. Recent architectures introduce Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) layers [ 26 ] . The Self-Attention module projects the previous layer’s hidden states into query (Q), Key (K), and value (V) vectors and computes attention scores that represent each token’s context awareness. In autoregressive inference, to avoid redundant recomputation, self-attention relies on the K and V vectors computed from the previous steps. LLM inference systems generally store these KV vectors in GPU memory to reduce the load latency. This memory cost becomes the performance bottleneck as the number of required KV vectors increases with the number of in-flight requests. Insufficient KV cache capacity may require the system to use a high-latency memory storage or preempt requests. These activities degrade performance and may cause the system to run at low utilization or fail to meet service-level objectives (SLOs).
paragraphs.zh: LLM 架构。 现代 LLM 通常由堆叠的解码器模块组成 [ 1 , 2 , 25 ] 。 每个模块进一步分解为自注意力（SA）和前馈（FFN）层。 近期的架构引入了专家混合（MoE）层 [ 26 ] 。 自注意力模块将前一层的状态向量投影为查询（Q）、键（K）和值（V）向量，并计算注意力得分，该得分表示每个词元的上下文感知能力。 在自回归推理中，为避免重复计算，自注意力依赖先前步骤中计算的 K 和 V 向量。 LLM 推理系统通常将这些 KV 向量存储在 GPU 内存中，以减少加载延迟。 随着待处理请求数量的增加，所需 KV 向量的数量也随之增长，这种内存成本便成为性能瓶颈。 KV 缓存容量不足可能导致系统不得不使用高延迟的存储设备或抢占部分请求。 这些操作会降低系统性能，并可能导致系统利用率低下或无法达到服务等级目标（SLO）。

paragraphs.en: LLM serving systems. LLM serving systems, such as vLLM [ 9 ] and SGLang [ 11 ] , focus on improving throughput and resource efficiency via various optimization techniques in scheduling and memory management. One essential optimization is continuous batching, which groups incoming requests into single batches to improve hardware utilization. vLLM introduces an advanced KV cache management algorithm, called PagedAttention or vLLM [ 9 ] . PagedAttention is inspired by virtual memory systems to enable flexible memory allocation and to share KV blocks between tokens and requests. These techniques also reduce memory fragmentation. SGLang uses prefix-aware caching and a reuse mechanism [ 11 ] to manage the KV cache. Despite these advances, most systems statically partition the memory space between the weight and KV caches at initialization time. Once allocated, the partitions remain fixed during the entire serving time. This design limits the flexibility to adjust the memory partitions in the presence of workload variation.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 服务系统。 LLM 服务系统，例如 vLLM [ 9 ] 和 SGLang [ 11 ] ，专注于通过调度和内存管理中的各种优化技术来提高吞吐量和资源效率。 一项关键的优化是连续批处理，即将传入的请求分组为单个批次以提高硬件利用率。vLLM 引入了一种先进的 KV 缓存管理算法，称为 PagedAttention 或 vLLM [ 9 ] 。 PagedAttention 的灵感来自虚拟内存系统，可实现灵活的内存分配，并在不同 token 和请求之间共享 KV 块。 这些技术还能减少内存碎片化。 SGLang 使用前缀感知缓存和重用机制 [ 11 ] 来管理 KV 缓存。 尽管取得了这些进展，大多数系统在初始化时仍以静态方式在权重和 KV 缓存之间划分内存空间。 一旦分配完成，这些分区在整个服务过程中将保持固定不变。 这种设计限制了在工作负载变化时调整内存分区的灵活性。

paragraphs.en: Unlike in computer vision tasks, LLMs often exhibit activation outliers [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] , making floating-point formats (e.g., FP16 and FP8) widely used. A floating-point format with x x exponent bits and y y mantissa bits is denoted as E ​ x ​ M ​ y ExMy . For instance, FP16 is also referred to as E5M10, where 5 and 10 bits are used for the exponent and mantissa, respectively. Two emerging FP8 formats, E5M2 and E4M3, are defined similarly. While FP16 has become the de facto standard for LLM serving, FP8 is attracting significant attention with two fundamental factors: (1) the representational advantages of floating-point formats to capture outliers, and (2) the increasing hardware support for FP8 arithmetic. Recent studies [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] have shown that FP8 can maintain high accuracy with only small degradation compared to FP16. For example, FP8 (E5M2) has the same number of exponent bits as FP16 but lower precision because it has fewer mantissa bits. More importantly, FP8 reduces the bandwidth requirement by up to 2 × 2\times , and FP8 is natively supported in arithmetic units by many modern hardware systems, including NVIDIA Hopper [ 15 ] , Intel Gaudi HPUs, or NPUs [ 31 ] .

paragraphs.en: Modern GPUs feature a hierarchical memory system, including high-bandwidth memory (HBM), on-chip caches (L1, L2, shared memory), and register files. The latency of accessing HBM is much higher than that of on-chip caches. However, on-chip cache sizes are much smaller. Therefore, optimizing LLM operations mostly involves fitting the working set into on-chip and register memory. During LLM inference, the prefill phase benefits from compute-intensive GEMM operations that efficiently utilize NVIDIA Tensor Cores (Matrix Cores for AMD GPUs). However, the decode phase is dominated by memory-bound operations that require frequent HBM access. This results in low arithmetic intensity and GPU utilization. As a result, optimizing memory usage and data movement is critical for improving overall system performance. In particular, reducing memory footprint or increasing effective memory capacity can directly translate into higher throughput.
paragraphs.zh: 现代 GPU 采用分层内存系统，包括高带宽内存（HBM）、片上缓存（L1、L2、共享内存）和寄存器文件。 访问 HBM 的延迟远高于访问片上缓存的延迟。 然而，片上缓存的容量要小得多。 因此，优化 LLM 操作主要涉及将工作集装入片上内存和寄存器内存中。 在 LLM 推理过程中，预填充阶段得益于计算密集型的 GEMM 操作，这些操作能高效利用 NVIDIA Tensor Cores（AMD GPU 称为 Matrix Cores）。 然而，解码阶段主要由受内存限制的操作主导，这些操作需要频繁访问 HBM。 这导致算术强度低且 GPU 利用率不高。 因此，优化内存使用和数据传输对于提升整体系统性能至关重要。 特别是，减少内存占用或增加有效内存容量可以直接带来更高的吞吐量。

paragraphs.en: Bursty LLM workloads. LLM serving systems face highly dynamic and bursty computing patterns due to substantial variability in the request arrival rates (i.e., request bursts), input prompt, and output sequence lengths across requests [ 32 , 33 ] . As illustrated in Figure 2 (a), the production workloads of the Microsoft Azure LLM services and BurstGPT reveal rapid fluctuations: the request rate exhibits nearly a fivefold variation between the lowest and highest load periods. In addition, these fluctuations occur with high temporal frequency, indicating second-level variability. These fluctuations pose a practical challenge for real-world LLM inference workloads, which are not fully captured in settings such as vLLM [ 9 ] . An important observation is that the periods of high KV cache pressure are not permanent; they are usually interleaved with low-pressure periods. This transience has two implications. First, static solutions that constantly trade quality for performance (e.g., always using FP8 or static weight offloading), or vice versa, are suboptimal because they incur a permanent cost for an intermittent problem. Second, rapid fluctuations demand a lightweight switching mechanism, which in turn requires an efficient system design. This observation motivates a fast, runtime-adaptive memory management mechanism that can elastically respond to different workload characteristics.
paragraphs.zh: 突发性的 LLM 工作负载。 由于请求到达率（即请求爆发）、输入提示和输出序列长度在不同请求间存在显著差异，LLM 服务系统面临着高度动态且突发的计算模式 [32, 33]。 如图 2(a) 所示，Microsoft Azure LLM 服务和 BurstGPT 的生产工作负载显示出快速波动：请求速率在最低和最高负载时段之间几乎存在五倍的差异。 此外，这些波动以极高的时间频率发生，表明存在秒级变化。 这些波动给实际场景中的 LLM 推理工作负载带来了现实挑战，而像 vLLM [9] 这样的设置未能完全捕捉到这一问题。 一个重要的观察是，高 KV 缓存压力的时段并非持续存在；它们通常与低压力时段交替出现。 这种暂时性具有两个含义。 首先，那些始终在质量与性能之间进行权衡的静态解决方案（例如，始终使用 FP8 或静态权重卸载），或者相反的做法，都是次优的，因为它们为间歇性问题承担了永久性成本。 其次，快速波动需要一个轻量级的切换机制，而这反过来又要求高效的系统设计。 这一观察促使我们提出一种快速、运行时自适应的内存管理机制，能够灵活应对不同的工作负载特性。

paragraphs.en: Long TTFT/TPOT and SLO violation. A request burst may cause a long Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) latency and SLO violations, as illustrated in Figure 2 (b). As the system load increases, even small surges can cause sharp spikes in TTFT latency. Specifically, a serving system quickly exceeds the SLO threshold once GPU memory becomes insufficient to schedule new requests for prefilling or to continue decoding for the ongoing batch. Consequently, an incoming request is forced to wait until memory is reclaimed, incurring significant queuing latency with SLO violation. The problem is exacerbated by long-context requests, especially in modern applications, where the context length can reach 32K-1M tokens [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 长期 TTFT/TPOT 和 SLO 违反。 请求爆发可能导致较长的首次令牌时间（TTFT）延迟和 SLO 违反，如图 2 (b) 所示。 随着系统负载增加，即使是微小的激增也可能导致 TTFT 延迟急剧上升。 具体来说，一旦 GPU 内存不足以为新请求安排预填充或为当前批次继续解码，服务系统就会迅速超过 SLO 阈值。 因此，新到达的请求被迫等待内存被释放，从而产生显著的排队延迟并违反 SLO。 长上下文请求会加剧这一问题，尤其是在现代应用中，其上下文长度可达 32K-1M 个令牌 [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] 。

paragraphs.en: KV Cache Pressure and Preemptions. The above issue can also be visualized via KV cache utilization or pressure. As the system load increases, the KV cache memory is highly utilized. When the request traffic surpasses the system’s capacity, the serving systems like vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] must prioritize a subset of requests and need to preempt some requests. As illustrated in Figure 2 (c), when the system load increases with high fluctuations, the KV cache memory is nearly full, and preemptions occur more frequently.
paragraphs.zh: KV 缓存压力与抢占。 上述问题也可以通过 KV 缓存利用率或压力进行可视化呈现。 随着系统负载增加，KV 缓存内存的利用率会非常高。 当请求流量超过系统容量时，像 vLLM [9, 10] 这样的服务系统必须优先处理部分请求，并需要抢占一些请求。 如图 2(c) 所示，当系统负载伴随大幅波动而增加时，KV 缓存内存几乎会被填满，且抢占现象会变得更加频繁。

paragraphs.en: Preemptions are particularly costly for long-context workloads. A preempted request incurs recomputation of the entire KV cache from scratch at the rescheduling point, or swapping all relevant KV cache items between GPU and CPU memory. Either way, the cost is proportional to the input context length. For a coding agent processing a 64K-token repository context, preemption can add seconds of latency that generally exceed SLO budgets. Lastly, preemption prevents current LLM-serving systems such as vLLM [ 9 ] and SGLang [ 12 ] from fully utilizing GPUs. As the context length continues to grow, driven by both user demand and model support, the preemption cost increases proportionally, making preemption-avoidance solutions more attractive for maintaining the SLO.
paragraphs.zh: 对于长上下文工作负载而言，抢占尤其代价高昂。 被抢占的请求在重新调度时，需要从头开始重新计算整个 KV 缓存，或者将所有相关的 KV 缓存项在 GPU 和 CPU 内存之间交换。 无论哪种方式，其成本都与输入上下文长度成正比。 对于处理 64K 令牌仓库上下文的编码智能体而言，抢占可能增加数秒的延迟，通常超出 SLO 预算。 最后，抢占会阻碍当前 LLM 服务系统（如 vLLM [9] 和 SGLang [12]）对 GPU 的充分利用。 随着上下文长度的持续增长——这既源于用户需求，也得益于模型支持——抢占成本也会相应增加，使得避免抢占的解决方案在维持 SLO 方面更具吸引力。

paragraphs.en: Opportunity. Dual-precision serving presents an opportunity to mitigate KV cache pressure. For example, consider a memory layout for serving a 13B model on an A100-40G GPU. When applying a nested FP8/FP16 model [ 24 ] , 13 GB, 13 GB, and 12 GB are primarily allocated for upper and lower FP8 weights and KV cache, respectively, accounting for 95% of the GPU memory. However, under a large number of requests, the serving system performs a fast mode that uses only 13 GB of upper FP8 weights for computation, thereby improving system performance. We observe that 13 GB of the lower FP8 weights can be deallocated and remapped to the KV cache. As a result, in this case, the KV cache can be elastically extended by 108.33% (= 13/12), significantly mitigating KV cache pressure and improving system throughput and SLOs. Meanwhile, when all 26 GB are used for the upper and lower FP8 weights, this preserves the behavior of an LLM serving system, such as vLLM [ 9 ] , under a full mode .
paragraphs.zh: 机遇。 双精度推理为缓解 KV 缓存压力提供了机遇。 例如，考虑在 A100-40G GPU 上运行 13B 模型时的内存布局。 当使用嵌套 FP8/FP16 模型 [ 24 ] 时，13 GB、13 GB 和 12 GB 的内存主要用于上层和下层 FP8 权重以及 KV 缓存，合计占 GPU 内存的 95%。 然而，在请求量较大时，推理系统会切换到快速模式，仅使用 13 GB 的上层 FP8 权重进行计算，从而提升系统性能。 我们观察到，下层 FP8 权重中的 13 GB 可以被释放并重新映射到 KV 缓存中。 因此，在这种情况下，KV 缓存可以弹性扩展 108.33%（= 13/12），显著缓解 KV 缓存压力，并提升系统吞吐量和 SLO。 同时，当全部 26 GB 都用于上层和下层 FP8 权重时，这能保持 LLM 推理系统（如 vLLM [ 9 ]）在全模式下的原有行为。

paragraphs.en: Challenge. The above dual-precision serving presents several challenges. Firstly, serving an LLM in full mode with both upper and lower weights should incur negligible overhead compared with a baseline system, such as [ 9 ] . Secondly, extending the KV cache size, for example, from 12GB to 25GB, must preserve the powerful page KV cache management in existing LLM serving systems. This requires a lightweight accuracy-to-performance mode switching and a virtual memory scheme to elastically extend the KV cache. Lastly, restoring a full mode from a fast mode intuitively requires loading 13 GB of lower FP8 weights from the host to GPU memory, which may cause considerable latency during serving. This poses a critical challenge for designing an effective mechanism for smooth fast-to-full mode switching.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战。 上述双精度推理带来了若干挑战。 首先，与基准系统（例如 [ 9 ]）相比，以完整模式运行 LLM 并同时使用上下权重不应产生显著开销。 其次，扩展 KV 缓存大小（例如从 12GB 扩展到 25GB）时，必须保留现有 LLM 推理系统中强大的页面级 KV 缓存管理能力。 这需要一个轻量级的精度-性能模式切换机制，以及一种可弹性扩展 KV 缓存的虚拟内存方案。 最后，从快速模式恢复完整模式时，直观上需要从主机将 13 GB 的下层 FP8 权重加载到 GPU 内存中，这可能会在推理过程中造成较大的延迟。 这对设计一种实现快速模式与完整模式之间平滑切换的有效机制构成了关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: Persistent and Dynamic Memory. This subsection revisits the fundamental concept of memory management in LLM-serving systems, such as vLLM [ 10 ] . Specifically, inspired by a traditional virtual memory mechanism in an operating system, KV blocks are typically managed in pages and dynamically (de)allocated during serving. Notably, a model’s parameters are typically assumed to be preloaded to GPU memory before serving and considered persistent during serving. For example, FP16 and FP8 models are loaded into a persistent region, as illustrated in Figures 3 (a) and (b), respectively. This assumption is intuitive because a typical LLM model is large, making it costly to transfer an entire model from CPU memory to GPU memory at runtime. Meanwhile, a fundamental observation is that if LLM inference can be performed with a partial model during serving, KV memory can be temporarily extended, possibly relaxing KV memory pressure and thereby improving system throughput. Intuitively, instead of being persistent, weight memory may be elastic, with parts of it mapped to KV blocks at runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 持久性与动态内存。 本小节重新探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统中的内存管理基本概念，例如 vLLM [ 10 ]。 具体而言，受操作系统中传统虚拟内存机制的启发，KV 块通常以页面为单位进行管理，并在服务过程中进行动态分配与回收。 值得注意的是，模型的参数通常在服务前预加载到 GPU 内存中，并在服务期间被视为持久存在。 例如，FP16 和 FP8 模型分别被加载到持久区域中，如图 3 (a) 和 (b) 所示。 这一假设是合理的，因为典型的大型语言模型规模庞大，在运行时将整个模型从 CPU 内存转移到 GPU 内存成本高昂。 同时，一个基本观察是：如果在服务过程中仅使用部分模型即可执行 LLM 推理，则 KV 内存可以临时扩展，从而可能缓解 KV 内存压力并提升系统吞吐量。 直观来看，权重内存可能并非持久存在，而是具有弹性，其部分内容可以在运行时映射到 KV 块中。

sents.en: For example, FP16 and FP8 models are loaded into a persistent region, as illustrated in Figures 3 (a) and (b), respectively.
sents.zh: 例如，FP16 和 FP8 模型分别被加载到持久区域中，如图 3 (a) 和 (b) 所示。

sents.en: This assumption is intuitive because a typical LLM model is large, making it costly to transfer an entire model from CPU memory to GPU memory at runtime.
sents.zh: 这一假设是合理的，因为典型的大型语言模型规模庞大，在运行时将整个模型从 CPU 内存转移到 GPU 内存成本高昂。

sents.en: Meanwhile, a fundamental observation is that if LLM inference can be performed with a partial model during serving, KV memory can be temporarily extended, possibly relaxing KV memory pressure and thereby improving system throughput.
sents.zh: 同时，一个基本观察是：如果在服务过程中仅使用部分模型即可执行 LLM 推理，则 KV 内存可以临时扩展，从而可能缓解 KV 内存压力并提升系统吞吐量。

sents.en: Intuitively, instead of being persistent, weight memory may be elastic, with parts of it mapped to KV blocks at runtime.
sents.zh: 直观来看，权重内存可能并非持久存在，而是具有弹性，其部分内容可以在运行时映射到 KV 块中。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic Networks and a Nested Model. Under bursty workloads, KV cache pressure and a demand for a KV cache extension may occur instantly, which becomes difficult to predict. To effectively handle such an instant KV pressure, a system must quickly switch from a persistent weight memory to a temporarily elastic one, leaving more space for KV blocks. Dynamic networks, including nested FP [ 24 ] , any precision networks [ 37 , 38 ] , early-exit networks [ 39 , 40 , 41 ] , provide a promising opportunity to address the challenge. Without loss of generality, let’s consider an FP16 model (e.g., E5M10) storing both an FP8 model (e.g., E5M2 or a custom E4M3 format [ 24 ] ) and a residual model, as illustrated in Figure 3 (c). More specifically, an FP16 model is split into two parts: an FP8 model (e.g., with upper (or MSB) weight tensors) stored in a persistent region and a residual model (e.g., with lower (or LSB) weight tensors) stored in a shared region. This can facilitate quick switching between FP16 and FP8 inference, temporarily freeing the residual model’s memory for KV blocks and thereby boosting system performance.
paragraphs.zh: 动态网络与嵌套模型。 在突发工作负载下，KV 缓存压力和对 KV 缓存扩展的需求可能瞬间出现，这使得预测变得困难。 为了有效应对这种突发的 KV 压力，系统必须迅速从持久性权重内存切换到临时弹性内存，从而为 KV 块腾出更多空间。 动态网络（包括嵌套 FP [24]、任意精度网络 [37, 38] 和提前退出网络 [39, 40, 41]）为解决这一挑战提供了很有前景的机会。 不失一般性地，我们考虑一个 FP16 模型（例如 E5M10），它同时存储一个 FP8 模型（例如 E5M2 或自定义的 E4M3 格式 [24]）和一个残差模型，如图 3(c) 所示。 更具体地说，一个 FP16 模型被分为两部分：一个 FP8 模型（例如包含高序位（或 MSB）权重张量）存储在持久性区域中，而一个残差模型（例如包含低序位（或 LSB）权重张量）则存储在共享区域中。 这有助于在 FP16 和 FP8 推理之间快速切换，临时释放残差模型的内存以用于 KV 块，从而提升系统性能。

paragraphs.en: Dual-Precision Serving (DPS) Overview. Inspired by the observations above, this subsection presents an overview of DPS, a dual-precision serving mechanism that can be directly integrated into existing LLM serving systems, such as vLLM [ 10 ] . DPS introduces a novel semi-unified memory (SUM) scheme. SUM is a memory abstraction that allows a shared physical region to dynamically back two distinct virtual tensors: one for the residual weights, the other for the KV cache pool. In the following subsection, we first discuss the SUM architecture and asymmetric mode switching. Next, dual-precision execution is explained in detail. Lastly, we provide a theoretical performance bound for a DPS problem.
paragraphs.zh: 双精度服务（DPS）概述。 受上述观察的启发，本小节介绍了 DPS 的概述。DPS 是一种双精度服务机制，可以直接集成到现有的 LLM 服务系统中，例如 vLLM [ 10 ]。 DPS 引入了一种新颖的半统一内存（SUM）方案。 SUM 是一种内存抽象，它允许一个共享的物理区域动态地为两个不同的虚拟张量提供支撑：一个用于残差权重，另一个用于 KV 缓存池。 在下一小节中，我们将首先讨论 SUM 架构和不对称模式切换。 接下来，将详细解释双精度执行。 最后，我们将为 DPS 问题提供一个理论性能边界。

paragraphs.en: SUM is composed of four main components: a persistent region holding the lower-precision representation of model weights, a shared region whose physical memory may back either residual high-precision weights or KV cache blocks, a CPU-side residual backup used for restoring residual weight data after it has been overwritten, and a coordinator, called the SUM Manager, that owns the binding state of the shared region and exposes allocation operations to the serving system.
paragraphs.zh: SUM 由四个主要组件构成：一个持久区域，用于存储模型权重的低精度表示；一个共享区域，其物理内存可用于存储残差高精度权重或 KV 缓存块；一个位于 CPU 端的残差备份，用于在残差权重数据被覆盖后将其恢复；以及一个协调器，即 SUM 管理器，它负责管理共享区域的绑定状态，并向服务系统提供分配操作。

paragraphs.en: Persistent Region. The persistent region holds the lower-precision representation of model weights. Specifically, the region can be used to store an FP8 model, as illustrated in Figure 4 (a). It is allocated via the standard PyTorch allocator at deployment startup and occupies a fixed portion of GPU memory throughout the deployment’s lifetime. Notably, this retains the structure of the conventional serving systems like vLLM [ 10 ] : the system can always execute a model, for example, an FP8 one, regardless of the state of the shared region or KV cache . For an FP8 model, one can directly obtain an FP8 tensor in E5M2 format from its corresponding FP16 (E5M10) tensor by using all five exponent bits and keeping the two MSB bits in the mantissas. In a specific case, if the range of data is small and the first MSB bit in the exponent is zero, one can obtain an FP8 tensor with an E4M3 format by keeping four out of five exponent bits and three MSB mantissa bits, as illustrated in Figure 4 (a). This has been exploited in [ 24 ] , as many layers in LLMs have a small weight range.
paragraphs.zh: 持久区域。 持久区域存储模型权重的低精度表示形式。 具体而言，该区域可用于存储 FP8 模型，如图 4 (a) 所示。 在部署启动时，该区域通过标准的 PyTorch 分配器进行分配，并在整个部署生命周期中占用固定的 GPU 内存部分。 值得注意的是，这与 vLLM [10] 等传统服务系统的结构保持一致：无论共享区域或 KV 缓存的状态如何，系统始终可以执行模型，例如 FP8 模型。 对于 FP8 模型，可以通过使用全部五个指数位并保留尾数中的两个最高有效位（MSB），直接从其对应的 FP16 (E5M10) 张量中获得 E5M2 格式的 FP8 张量。 在特定情况下，如果数据范围较小且指数中的第一个最高有效位为零，则可以通过保留五个指数位中的四个以及三个最高有效尾数位，获得 E4M3 格式的 FP8 张量，如图 4 (a) 所示。 [24] 已利用这一特性，因为许多大型语言模型（LLM）的层都具有较小的权重范围。

paragraphs.en: Shared Region. The shared region is the elastic component of SUM. It consists of two primitives: physical units and virtual tensors . A physical unit is a contiguous region of GPU memory configured via the CUDA Virtual Memory Management (VMM) API [ 42 , 43 ] . A virtual tensor is a contiguous virtual address range exposed to the serving system through standard tensor access patterns. CUDA VMM separates virtual address reservation, physical handle allocation, and mapping between them, allowing a single physical handle to be mapped into multiple virtual addresses simultaneously and remapped at runtime. SUM relies on this separation to maintain dynamic bindings between physical units and virtual tensors.
paragraphs.zh: 共享区域。 共享区域是 SUM 的弹性组件。 它由两种基础元素组成：物理单元和虚拟张量。 物理单元是通过 CUDA 虚拟内存管理（VMM）API [42, 43] 配置的连续 GPU 内存区域。 虚拟张量是一个连续的虚拟地址范围，通过标准的张量访问模式向服务系统暴露。 CUDA VMM 将虚拟地址预留、物理句柄分配以及两者之间的映射分离开来，使得单个物理句柄可以同时映射到多个虚拟地址，并在运行时重新映射。 SUM 依赖这种分离来维持物理单元与虚拟张量之间的动态绑定。

paragraphs.en: It is essentially noted that SUM, in particular the shared region, builds a bridge between a persistent model and a dynamic page-based KV cache memory in a serving system, such as vLLM [ 10 ] , as demonstrated in Figure 4 . When the physical shared memory is entirely allocated to page-based (virtual) KV blocks, this facilitates serving an FP8 model stored in the persistent region. This refers to a fast mode in which the KV cache can fully utilize shared memory, thereby possibly reducing KV cache pressure and preemptions and boosting performance. It can also increase system throughput by leveraging FP8 computing, e.g., halving memory accesses by 2x or doubling peak tensor-core throughput with hardware support [ 24 , 15 ] . Meanwhile, the shared region can be overlaid and assigned to a partial persistent model. For example, as described in Figure 4 (a), the shared region can be configured to store a residual FP8 model that is combined with the FP8 model in the persistent region to form an FP16 model. This enables a full mode because the entire FP16 model becomes persistent in GPU memory, as in conventional vLLM [ 10 ] with FP16 model execution. Essentially, SUM provides a wrapper for a persistent model and a dynamic page-based KV cache in a serving system, while retaining effective KV cache management as in existing serving systems, such as vLLM [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 需要重点指出的是，SUM（尤其是共享区域）在服务器系统中充当了持久化模型与动态基于页面的 KV 缓存内存之间的桥梁，例如 vLLM [ 10 ]，如图 4 所示。 当物理共享内存完全分配给基于页面的（虚拟）KV 块时，这有助于运行存储在持久化区域中的 FP8 模型。 这指的是一种快速模式，其中 KV 缓存可以充分利用共享内存，从而可能减少 KV 缓存的压力和抢占，并提升性能。 通过利用 FP8 计算，它还可以提高系统吞吐量，例如，借助硬件支持将内存访问次数减半 [ 24 , 15 ]，或将张量核心的峰值吞吐量翻倍。 同时，共享区域可以叠加并分配给部分持久化模型。 例如，如图 4 (a) 所述，共享区域可以被配置为存储一个残差 FP8 模型，该模型与持久化区域中的 FP8 模型结合，形成一个 FP16 模型。 这使得全模式成为可能，因为整个 FP16 模型都变成了 GPU 内存中的持久化模型，就像传统 vLLM [ 10 ] 中执行 FP16 模型那样。 本质上，SUM 为服务器系统中的持久化模型和动态基于页面的 KV 缓存提供了一个封装层，同时保留了现有服务器系统（如 vLLM [ 10 ]）中有效的 KV 缓存管理机制。

paragraphs.en: Residual Backup. The residual backup is a pinned, CPU-side copy of all transformer layers’ residual weight tensors, initialized once at deployment startup. It serves as the source for restoring residual weights after physical units have been overwritten by KV cache writes. More specifically, after the physical shared memory is entirely assigned to page-based (virtual) KV blocks, the residual weights in GPU memory are lost and overwritten by KV. When KV blocks are freed, leaving sufficient space in the shared region for a residual weight, the residual backup provides a source for reloading residual weights from CPU into the shared region on GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 残差备份。 残差备份是 Transformer 各层残差权重张量的一个固定、位于 CPU 端的副本，在部署启动时初始化一次。 当物理单元被 KV 缓存写入覆盖后，它可作为恢复残差权重的来源。 更具体地说，在物理共享内存完全分配给基于页面的（虚拟）KV 块之后，GPU 内存中的残差权重会被丢失并由 KV 覆盖。 当 KV 块被释放，且共享区域中为残差权重留出足够空间时，残差备份可作为从 CPU 将残差权重重新加载到 GPU 共享区域的来源。

sents.en: Residual Backup.
sents.zh: 残差备份。

sents.en: The residual backup is a pinned, CPU-side copy of all transformer layers’ residual weight tensors, initialized once at deployment startup.
sents.zh: 残差备份是 Transformer 各层残差权重张量的一个固定、位于 CPU 端的副本，在部署启动时初始化一次。

sents.en: It serves as the source for restoring residual weights after physical units have been overwritten by KV cache writes.
sents.zh: 当物理单元被 KV 缓存写入覆盖后，它可作为恢复残差权重的来源。

sents.en: More specifically, after the physical shared memory is entirely assigned to page-based (virtual) KV blocks, the residual weights in GPU memory are lost and overwritten by KV.
sents.zh: 更具体地说，在物理共享内存完全分配给基于页面的（虚拟）KV 块之后，GPU 内存中的残差权重会被丢失并由 KV 覆盖。

sents.en: When KV blocks are freed, leaving sufficient space in the shared region for a residual weight, the residual backup provides a source for reloading residual weights from CPU into the shared region on GPU.
sents.zh: 当 KV 块被释放，且共享区域中为残差权重留出足够空间时，残差备份可作为从 CPU 将残差权重重新加载到 GPU 共享区域的来源。

paragraphs.en: SUM manager. The SUM Manager maintains the binding state of all physical units in the shared region and records the current mapping between physical units and virtual tensors. It processes allocation and deallocation requests for KV cache blocks issued by the serving system. When an allocation request targets units that hold no residual data, the SUM Manager returns the requested blocks directly. When a request targets a unit holding a residual-weight virtual tensor, the SUM Manager signals the precision-mode transition to the model executor and marks the affected residual mapping as stale.
paragraphs.zh: SUM 管理器。 SUM 管理器维护共享区域中所有物理单元的结合状态，并记录物理单元与虚拟张量之间的当前映射关系。 它处理由服务系统发出的 KV 缓存块的分配和释放请求。 当分配请求的目标是未保留任何残留数据的单元时，SUM 管理器会直接返回所请求的块。 当请求的目标是保留有残留权重虚拟张量的单元时，SUM 管理器会向模型执行器发出精度模式转换的信号，并将受影响的残留映射标记为过时。

sents.en: SUM manager.

sents.zh: 它处理由服务系统发出的 KV 缓存块的分配和释放请求。

sents.en: When an allocation request targets units that hold no residual data, the SUM Manager returns the requested blocks directly.
sents.zh: 当分配请求的目标是未保留任何残留数据的单元时，SUM 管理器会直接返回所请求的块。

sents.en: When a request targets a unit holding a residual-weight virtual tensor, the SUM Manager signals the precision-mode transition to the model executor and marks the affected residual mapping as stale.
sents.zh: 当请求的目标是保留有残留权重虚拟张量的单元时，SUM 管理器会向模型执行器发出精度模式转换的信号，并将受影响的残留映射标记为过时。

paragraphs.en: The SUM Manager observes deallocation events from the serving system to identify physical units whose KV cache blocks have all been freed. It enqueues a restore task for each such unit, and a background worker thread internal to the SUM Manager processes the queue: for each task, the worker selects a stale residual weight virtual tensor, unmaps it from its previous unit, maps it to the reclaimable unit, and copies the layer’s residual weight data from the residual backup into the unit. Once all layers’ residual weight data have been restored, the SUM Manager signals the model executor to transition back to full-precision execution. Performing restore work in the background keeps VMM operation latency off the allocation and deallocation hot path.
paragraphs.zh: SUM 管理器会观察服务系统的释放事件，以识别那些 KV 缓存块已全部释放的物理单元。 它为每个此类单元排队一个恢复任务，SUM 管理器内部的一个后台工作线程会处理该队列：对于每个任务，该工作线程会选择一个过时的残差权重虚拟张量，将其从之前的单元解映射，然后将其映射到可回收的单元，并将层的残差权重数据从残差备份复制到该单元中。 所有层的残差权重数据恢复完成后，SUM 管理器会向模型执行器发出信号，使其切换回全精度执行模式。 在后台执行恢复工作，可使 VMM 操作的延迟不会影响到分配和释放的热路径。

paragraphs.en: Dual-mapping property. An alternative design would unmap each physical unit before rebinding it to a different virtual tensor, avoiding the dual-mapping property entirely. Such a design is incompatible with vLLM’s asynchronous scheduling model. In this model, the scheduler may mark KV blocks as free while GPU workers still hold in-flight reads issued against those blocks by earlier submitted work. If freeing a KV block involved unmapping its backing unit, the in-flight reads would access unmapped memory, causing an illegal memory access error. Resolving this race would require synchronizing the scheduler against the workers on every free event, which defeats the purpose of asynchronous scheduling. SUM avoids the race by construction: the KV virtual tensor is permanently mapped to every physical unit in the shared region, so marking a unit’s residual mapping as stale does not affect the KV mapping, and in-flight reads through the KV path remain valid regardless of residual state.
paragraphs.zh: 双重映射特性。 另一种设计方法是在将每个物理单元重新绑定到不同的虚拟张量之前先取消映射，从而完全避免双重映射特性。 这种设计与 vLLM 的异步调度模型不兼容。 在此模型中，调度器可能会将 KV 块标记为空闲，而 GPU 工作者仍持有由先前提交的任务针对这些块发出的未完成的读取请求。 如果释放 KV 块需要取消映射其底层物理单元，那么这些未完成的读取请求就会访问未映射的内存，导致非法内存访问错误。 要解决这种竞争条件，需要在每次释放事件时让调度器与工作者同步，但这会违背异步调度的初衷。 SUM 通过其设计本身避免了这种竞争：KV 虚拟张量被永久地映射到共享区域中的每个物理单元，因此将某个单元的剩余映射标记为过时并不会影响 KV 映射，且通过 KV 路径进行的未完成的读取请求无论剩余状态如何都保持有效。

paragraphs.en: Overall concept. SUM facilitates non-stop execution and can be integrated into vLLM, as illustrated in Figure 5 . Specifically, at runtime, the model executor follows one of two paths depending on the chosen mode. In a full mode , it combines the FP8 weight tensor from the persistent region with the residual weight tensor from the shared region to reconstruct the original FP16 values during computation. In a fast mode , only the FP8 weight tensor is used; the residual weight tensor in the shared region is not accessed, and its physical memory may at this point be holding KV cache data rather than residual weight data. The SUM Manager assigns a current precision mode to each worker, and the model executor reads that mode at the start of each forward pass. This mode is set to a fast mode when the SUM Manager processes an allocation request that overwrites a residual-bound unit, and reset to a full mode when the background restore worker has populated all residual weight tensors. Mode transitions are batch-aligned: the SUM Manager updates the mode only between forward passes, and the model executor executes each pass entirely in a single mode. Obviously, SUM also enables single-mode execution.
paragraphs.zh: 总体概念。 SUM 支持不间断执行，并且可以集成到 vLLM 中，如图 5 所示。 具体来说，在运行时，模型执行器会根据所选模式沿两条路径之一运行。 在全模式下，它会将持久化区域中的 FP8 权重张量与共享区域中的残差权重张量结合，在计算过程中重建原始的 FP16 值。 在快速模式下，仅使用 FP8 权重张量；共享区域中的残差权重张量不会被访问，此时其物理内存中可能存储的是 KV 缓存数据，而非残差权重数据。 SUM 管理器为每个工作器分配一个当前的精度模式，模型执行器在每个前向传播开始时读取该模式。 当 SUM 管理器处理覆盖残差绑定单元的资源分配请求时，会将此模式设置为快速模式；当后台恢复工作器填充完所有残差权重张量后，则会将其重置为全模式。 模式转换与批处理对齐：SUM 管理器仅在前后向传播之间更新模式，而模型执行器会在每次前向传播中完全使用单一模式执行。 显然，SUM 也支持单模式执行。

paragraphs.en: Dual-mode serving (DPS) with asymmetric switching. This subsection unleashes the power of SUM for dual-precision serving. Notably, runtime switching for LLM serving with multi-precision representations has recently been discussed [ 24 , 38 , 44 ] . DPS implements GroupedGEMM kernels that perform NestedFP-style reconstruction [ 24 , 21 ] and support dense LLMs and MoE models. DPS extends the encoding scheme with an alternative FP8 E5M2 representation for layers whose weight magnitudes fall outside the range that E4M3 can express. With this extension, all projection layers in the model are eligible for FP8 execution, and the per-layer encoding is selected offline at model loading time based on weight statistics. Inspired by [ 24 ] , SUM facilitates a nearly-zero-cost switching from a full mode to a fast mode , as described in Figure 4 (b). Specifically, because the FP8 model is in the persistent region, the system can execute it directly without stalling while loading a new model. It is especially effective for bursty workloads because the demand for a fast mode appears instantly and non-deterministically. More importantly, unlike [ 24 ] , the shared memory for the (previously persistent) residual weight is unmapped and reallocated to KV cache blocks, effectively mitigating high KV cache pressure and potentially reducing preemptions.
paragraphs.zh: 具有非对称切换的双模式服务（DPS）。 本小节释放了 SUM 在双精度服务中的强大能力。 值得注意的是，最近已有研究探讨了使用多精度表示的 LLM 服务中的运行时切换 [ 24 , 38 , 44 ] 。 DPS 实现了 GroupedGEMM 内核，该内核执行 NestedFP 风格的重构 [ 24 , 21 ]，并支持密集 LLM 和 MoE 模型。 DPS 扩展了编码方案，为权重幅度超出 E4M3 表示范围的层引入了替代的 FP8 E5M2 表示。 通过这一扩展，模型中的所有投影层都具备使用 FP8 执行的条件，且每层的编码在模型加载时根据权重统计信息离线选择。 受 [ 24 ] 启发，SUM 实现了从全模式到快速模式的近乎零成本的切换，如图 4 (b) 所示。 具体而言，由于 FP8 模型处于持久区域，系统可以直接执行它，而无需在加载新模型时出现停顿。 对于突发式工作负载，这种方法尤其有效，因为对快速模式的需求会即时且非确定性地出现。 更重要的是，与 [ 24 ] 不同，（先前处于持久区域的）残差权重的共享内存会被取消映射并重新分配给 KV 缓存块，从而有效缓解较高的 KV 缓存压力，并可能减少抢占。

paragraphs.en: SUM also facilitates a restoration of a full mode , as illustrated in Figure 4 (c). Restoration is the process of bringing the residual weight (the lower FP8 byte) back from CPU memory to GPU memory so that subsequent forward passes can run in a full mode . We use a dedicated non-blocking copy stream to perform the required Host-to-device (H2D) memory copy and to overlap it with the ongoing computation. Since GPUs generally have a single PCIe copy engine, long H2D copies can stall the entire decoding pipeline. To avoid this problem, we schedule copies in small chunks and let other system H2D copies run between chunk copies. This fragmentation deliberately leaves the engine between chunks so that small H2D traffic from the request scheduler can interleave without significant delay. At engine startup, when many copies are issued back-to-back and no other PCIe traffic is present, the system uses a simpler one-shot path: each copy is a single asynchronous transfer, terminated by a CUDA event that the compute stream waits on. Chunking is only reserved for the runtime restore path. Empirically, we observe that a fixed chunk size of 4MiB works well for most cases. Notably, because H2D transfers overlap with ongoing inference and there is no synchronous wait that pauses the engine, the actual cost paid is therefore not the duration of the transfer but the slight PCIe contention it imposes on per-step scheduler uploads, which the chunked yield design is meant to bound.
paragraphs.zh: SUM 还促进了对完整模式的恢复，如图 4(c) 所示。 恢复是指将残差权重（较低的 FP8 字节）从 CPU 内存写回 GPU 内存的过程，以便后续的顺传播计算能够在完整模式下运行。 我们使用一个专用的非阻塞复制流来执行所需的主机到设备（H2D）内存复制操作，并将其与正在进行的计算重叠执行。 由于 GPU 通常只有一个 PCIe 复制引擎，较长的 H2D 复制操作可能会使整个解码流水线停滞。 为避免这个问题，我们将复制操作拆分为小块进行调度，并允许其他系统的 H2D 复制操作在小块复制之间运行。 这种碎片化设计特意在相邻小块之间留出引擎空闲时间，以便请求调度器产生的小量 H2D 流量能够交错执行而不会造成显著延迟。 在引擎启动时，当大量复制操作连续发出且没有其他 PCIe 流量存在时，系统会采用更简单的单次传输路径：每次复制都是一个异步传输，由一个 CUDA 事件终止，计算流则等待该事件完成。 分块机制仅保留用于运行时恢复路径。 根据经验观察，4MiB 的固定小块大小在大多数情况下都能良好工作。 值得注意的是，由于 H2D 传输与正在进行的推理重叠执行，且没有同步等待导致引擎暂停，因此实际付出的成本并非传输本身所花费的时间，而是其对每一步调度器上传操作造成的轻微 PCIe 竞争；而分块让路的设计正是为了限制这种竞争。

sents.zh: 恢复是指将残差权重（较低的 FP8 字节）从 CPU 内存写回 GPU 内存的过程，以便后续的顺传播计算能够在完整模式下运行。

sents.en: We use a dedicated non-blocking copy stream to perform the required Host-to-device (H2D) memory copy and to overlap it with the ongoing computation.
sents.zh: 我们使用一个专用的非阻塞复制流来执行所需的主机到设备（H2D）内存复制操作，并将其与正在进行的计算重叠执行。

sents.en: Since GPUs generally have a single PCIe copy engine, long H2D copies can stall the entire decoding pipeline.
sents.zh: 由于 GPU 通常只有一个 PCIe 复制引擎，较长的 H2D 复制操作可能会使整个解码流水线停滞。

sents.en: To avoid this problem, we schedule copies in small chunks and let other system H2D copies run between chunk copies.
sents.zh: 为避免这个问题，我们将复制操作拆分为小块进行调度，并允许其他系统的 H2D 复制操作在小块复制之间运行。

sents.en: This fragmentation deliberately leaves the engine between chunks so that small H2D traffic from the request scheduler can interleave without significant delay.
sents.zh: 这种碎片化设计特意在相邻小块之间留出引擎空闲时间，以便请求调度器产生的小量 H2D 流量能够交错执行而不会造成显著延迟。

sents.en: At engine startup, when many copies are issued back-to-back and no other PCIe traffic is present, the system uses a simpler one-shot path: each copy is a single asynchronous transfer, terminated by a CUDA event that the compute stream waits on.
sents.zh: 在引擎启动时，当大量复制操作连续发出且没有其他 PCIe 流量存在时，系统会采用更简单的单次传输路径：每次复制都是一个异步传输，由一个 CUDA 事件终止，计算流则等待该事件完成。

sents.en: Chunking is only reserved for the runtime restore path.
sents.zh: 分块机制仅保留用于运行时恢复路径。

sents.en: Empirically, we observe that a fixed chunk size of 4MiB works well for most cases.
sents.zh: 根据经验观察，4MiB 的固定小块大小在大多数情况下都能良好工作。

sents.en: Notably, because H2D transfers overlap with ongoing inference and there is no synchronous wait that pauses the engine, the actual cost paid is therefore not the duration of the transfer but the slight PCIe contention it imposes on per-step scheduler uploads, which the chunked yield design is meant to bound.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，由于 H2D 传输与正在进行的推理重叠执行，且没有同步等待导致引擎暂停，因此实际付出的成本并非传输本身所花费的时间，而是其对每一步调度器上传操作造成的轻微 PCIe 竞争；而分块让路的设计正是为了限制这种竞争。

paragraphs.en: Granularity of the precision switch. Notably, restoration cannot itself preempt or replay a request; once a request’s decode has produced a token under single-weight precision, the token is final, and only subsequent decode steps are affected by the restored precision. The system pre-captures two CUDA graphs per supported batch size: one with single-weight (FP8-only) and the other with dual-weight (FP8+residual) kernels. The dispatcher picks exactly one for each forward pass. As a result, a precision change takes effect at scheduling-step boundaries, never within a step: every layer in a given forward pass runs at the same precision. paragraphs.en: Precision-switching Algorithm. This subsection presents a DPS algorithm based on KV cache pressure. The central idea is to build a KV block allocation and deallocation/free with SUM, as summarized in Algorithm 1 . This is based on runtime internal states of SUM, including Free , Backed , Avail , Full , and Stale . Specifically, Free stores free physical units that are not assigned to either a KV block or a residual weight block. Backed saves units bound to residual weight virtual tensors. While Avail marks KV units with at least one free block, Full indicates KV units with no free blocks. Stale marks invalid residual mappings awaiting restoration.
paragraphs.zh: 精确切换算法。 本小节介绍一种基于 KV 缓存压力的 DPS 智能体算法。 其核心思想是利用 SUM 构建 KV 块的分配与释放/自由机制，具体如算法 1 所示。 该机制基于 SUM 在运行时的内部状态，包括 Free、Backed、Avail、Full 和 Stale。 具体来说，Free 存储未分配给 KV 块或残差权重块的自由物理单元。 Backed 保存与残差权重虚拟张量绑定的单元。 而 Avail 标记至少有一个自由块的 KV 单元，Full 则表示没有自由块的 KV 单元。 Stale 标记等待恢复的无效残差映射。

paragraphs.en: The KV block allocation is presented in lines 6-28 of Algorithm 1 . Consider a request to allocate n n new KV blocks and let u u be a temporary list to store physical units for these KV blocks. The procedure starts by checking if Avail is empty. If there are no KV units with at least one free block (line 9), it first tries to find an empty allocation slot in Free (lines 10-11). Notably, this step retains effective KV management in a serving system such as vLLM [ 10 ] . The key idea is that if an unused slot exists in the KV cache, it reserves it for a new KV block by updating the allocation slot list u u . Meanwhile, if there is no available slot and this is under a full mode (e.g., non-empty Backed ) (line 12), it updates u u from Backed (line 13) and marks the residual mapping of u u as stale (line 15). Also, it activates a fast mode (line 14). This step clearly demonstrates that DPS can instantly switch from a full mode to a fast mode to resolve KV cache pressure (e.g., empty Free ). Lastly, the allocation slot list u u is used to allocate KV blocks (lines 21-25).
paragraphs.zh: KV 块分配在算法 1 的第 6-28 行中进行了描述。 假设有一个请求需要分配 n 个新的 KV 块，并设 u 为一个临时列表，用于存储这些 KV 块的物理单元。 该流程首先检查 Avail 是否为空。 如果没有至少包含一个空闲块的 KV 单元（第 9 行），系统会先尝试在 Free 中查找一个空的分配槽位（第 10-11 行）。 值得注意的是，这一步骤保留了服务系统（如 vLLM [10]）中的有效 KV 管理机制。 其核心思想是：如果 KV 缓存中存在未使用的槽位，则通过更新分配槽位列表 u 来将其保留用于新的 KV 块。 同时，如果没有可用槽位且系统处于满负荷模式（例如 Backed 非空）（第 12 行），系统会从 Backed 中更新 u（第 13 行），并将 u 的剩余映射标记为过时（第 15 行）。 此外，系统还会激活快速模式（第 14 行）。 这一步清楚地表明，DPS 可以立即从满负荷模式切换到快速模式，以缓解 KV 缓存压力（例如 Free 为空）。 最后，分配槽位列表 u 被用于分配 KV 块（第 21-25 行）。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare DPS against three static-precision configurations — BF16 (native), static FP8 (symmetric static per-channel weights and symmetric dynamic per-token activations [ 49 , 27 , 23 ] ), and NestedFP — plus three baselines that relieve KV pressure through orthogonal mechanisms, all implemented in vLLM [ 9 ] . KV-Offload evicts least-recently-used KV blocks to pinned CPU memory once the GPU KV pool is exhausted and reloads them on demand. KV-Quant stores keys and values in FP8, enlarging the effective KV pool at the cost of dequantization on the read path. Weight-Offload keeps a fraction of the weights in pinned CPU memory and streams them in during each forward pass, freeing HBM for additional KV blocks; we use vLLM’s offloading mechanism with the per-model configuration that yields the best performance.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们将 DPS 与三种静态精度配置进行比较：BF16（原生）、静态 FP8（每通道对称静态权重和每词元对称动态激活 [49, 27, 23]）以及 NestedFP；此外还包括三种通过正交机制缓解 KV 压力的基线方法，所有方法均在 vLLM [9] 中实现。 当 GPU 的 KV 池耗尽时，KV-Offload 会将最近最少使用的 KV 块驱逐到固定的 CPU 内存中，并在需要时重新加载它们。 KV-Quant 将键和值存储为 FP8 格式，从而扩大有效 KV 池，但代价是在读取路径上需要进行反量化操作。 Weight-Offload 将部分权重保留在固定的 CPU 内存中，并在每次前向传播时将其流式传输进来，从而释放 HBM 以容纳更多的 KV 块；我们使用 vLLM 的卸载机制，并采用每模型配置中性能最佳的那一种。

paragraphs.en: SLO definition. Following Sarathi-Serve [ 50 ] , T base T_{\text{base}} is the P99 decode iteration time for a batch of 32 requests with 4k context and no prefill interference. We measure it on the FP16 configuration, which is DPS’s base mode before any fallback to FP8, so the SLO is consistent across all systems: T base = 19.74 T_{\text{base}}=19.74 , 18.19 18.19 , and 23.03 23.03 ms on Phi-3.5-MoE, Qwen3-30B-A3B, and GLM-4.7-Flash, respectively. A request satisfies the joint SLO iff (1) its maximum intra-request time-between-tokens (TBT) is ≤ 5 × T base \leq 5\times T_{\text{base}} and (2) its time-to-first-token (TTFT) is ≤ 2000 \leq 2000 ms. Following DistServe [ 51 ] and SLOs-Serve [ 52 ] , system capacity is the highest sustained mean rate at which ≥ 90 % \geq 90\% of requests satisfy this SLO.
paragraphs.zh: SLO 定义。 遵循 Sarathi-Serve [ 50 ]，T base T_{\text{base}} 是指一批包含 32 个请求、上下文为 4k 且无预填充干扰时的 P99 解码迭代时间。 我们在 FP16 配置下对其进行测量，这是 DPS 在切换到 FP8 之前的基础模式，因此所有系统的 SLO 保持一致：T base = 19.74 T_{\text{base}}=19.74、18.19 18.19 以及 23.03 23.03 ms，分别对应 Phi-3.5-MoE、Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 GLM-4.7-Flash。 一个请求满足联合 SLO 当且仅当：(1) 其请求内最大词元间时间（TBT）≤ 5 × T base \leq 5\times T_{\text{base}}，且 (2) 其首个词元出现时间（TTFT）≤ 2000 \leq 2000 ms。 遵循 DistServe [ 51 ] 和 SLOs-Serve [ 52 ]，系统容量是指至少有 ≥ 90 % \geq 90\% 的请求满足此 SLO 时所能维持的最高平均速率。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Accuracy is task quality on LiveCodeBench and MMLU-Pro; performance is serving behavior under the accelerated BurstGPT [ 33 ] and Azure traces. Because conventional benchmarks score model quality in isolation and ignore latency, we also report effective pass@1 [ 51 , 53 , 54 ] , the fraction of submitted requests that both satisfy the joint SLO and produce a correct answer per the benchmark’s standard pass@1: effective pass@1 = SLO attainment × pass@1 served \text{effective pass@1}=\text{SLO attainment}\times\text{pass@1}_{\text{served}} . Requests that miss the SLO contribute zero regardless of accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 准确性指在 LiveCodeBench 和 MMLU-Pro 上的任务质量；性能指在加速后的 BurstGPT [ 33 ] 和 Azure 追踪数据下的服务行为。 由于传统基准测试仅评估模型质量而忽略延迟，我们还报告了有效 pass@1 [ 51 , 53 , 54 ]，即已提交请求中同时满足联合 SLO 且根据基准测试的标准 pass@1 生成正确答案的请求比例：有效 pass@1 = SLO 达成率 × 服务通过的 pass@1 \text{effective pass@1}=\text{SLO attainment}\times\text{pass@1}_{\text{served}}。 未满足 SLO 的请求无论准确性如何均计为零。

paragraphs.en: Phi-3.5-MoE: Low-Pressure Regime. Phi-3.5-MoE is underloaded over the tested rate range: KV cache never saturates, all seven methods hold ≥ 97 % \geq 97\% SLO attainment up to 8.5 req/s, and effective pass@1 sits within a 19.1–21.0% envelope (2 pp wide) that reflects benchmark noise rather than method differentiation. DPS stays inside this envelope at every rate, showing that the SUM operational cost (CUDA VMM mappings, allocator state tracking, controller polling) imposes no measurable accuracy cost when the dynamic mechanism is dormant; This addresses the natural concern that DPS’s runtime infrastructure might tax simple workloads. Throughput tells the same story. Static FP8 leads, Weight-Offload trails, and DPS, static FP16, and NestedFP stay within 15% of static FP8. In this regime, DPS reduces to its base configuration: FP16 execution with no mode transitions, and it matches static FP16 on every operational metric. This also serves as a multi-GPU sanity check, since Phi-3.5-MoE requires TP = 2 =2 on H100: DPS’s per-rank shared regions and SUM Manager broadcasts add nothing on top of the tensor-parallel cost that static FP16 already pays.

paragraphs.en: The Static FP16 collapse is not a quality failure: its unconditional pass@1 at 4.5 req/s remains ∼ 57.4 % \sim 57.4\% . The collapse stems from SLO violations: Static FP16 has limited KV cache capacity, and under pressure, many requests violate the SLO, contributing zero to effective pass@1. NestedFP, KV-Offload , and KV-Quant collapse similarly; KV-Quant degrades more gracefully because per-token KV reduction expands effective capacity, but still trails DPS by 9–14 pp across the burst region. Static FP8 tracks DPS throughout (56.5% vs. 56.4% at 4.5 req/s), but pays its quality cost permanently rather than only during bursts. Throughput and latency expose the mechanism. NestedFP gains nothing over Static FP16 (0.94 RPS) because its GPU memory is used to store the dual-precision weight. paragraphs.en: On the latency side, mean TTFT for static FP16 climbs from 910 ms at req/s of 2.0 to 10.3 s at 3.0, while DPS holds at 130–147 ms up to req/s of 4.5 (vs. 24 s for static FP16, a roughly 165 × \times reduction). DPS’s mean TTFT remains within the 2-second prefill threshold throughout its operating range (0.46 s at req/s of 6.0), while FP16 has long since left it. TPOT splits the methods into three tiers: Static FP8 is fastest (14–26 ms), DPS sits slightly higher due to its reconstruction cost (22–30 ms), and Static FP16 is slowest (21–35 ms). The offloading baselines degrade much more sharply under load: KV-Offload climbs to 71 ms because every decode step fetches KV blocks from CPU memory, and Weight-Offload stays permanently above 60 ms because every forward pass touches a fraction of host-resident weights. DPS’s background restore stays off the decode hot path: residual transfers run on a separate copy stream and mode transitions are batch-aligned (Section IV-D ).
paragraphs.zh: 在延迟方面，静态 FP16 的平均 TTFT 从请求/秒为 2.0 时的 910 毫秒攀升至请求/秒为 3.0 时的 10.3 秒，而 DPS 的请求/秒高达 4.5 时，其延迟仍保持在 130–147 毫秒（相比之下，静态 FP16 的延迟为 24 秒，降幅约为 165 倍）。 DPS 的平均 TTFT 在整个工作范围内（请求/秒为 6.0 时为 0.46 秒）始终保持在 2 秒的预填充阈值以内，而 FP16 早已超出该阈值。 TPOT 将各方法分为三个层级：静态 FP8 最快（14–26 毫秒），DPS 因重建成本略高（22–30 毫秒），而静态 FP16 最慢（21–35 毫秒）。 在负载条件下，卸载基线方法的性能下降更为剧烈：KV-Offload 的延迟攀升至 71 毫秒，因为每个解码步骤都需要从 CPU 内存中获取 KV 块；Weight-Offload 的延迟则始终高于 60 毫秒，因为每次前向传播都会访问主机内存中的一部分权重。 DPS 的背景恢复过程不会进入解码热点路径：剩余数据传输在独立的复制流中运行，且模式转换会与批处理对齐（见第四节 D 部分）。

paragraphs.en: Summary . Across the three regimes, a consistent story emerges. At low load, DPS pays a few-millisecond TPOT overhead and at most 25 ms TTFT overhead for SUM bookkeeping and FP16 reconstruction. Once KV pressure binds, DPS delivers 2.1–3.3 × \times higher sustained throughput, two-orders-of-magnitude TTFT improvements over Static FP16, and better effective pass@1. Under KV pressure, DPS ’s elastic KV capacity reduces preemption, lets DPS keep larger active batches, and amortizes per-step weight reads, while Static FP16’s fixed budget cannot hold a full batch. Static FP8 is the only baseline matching DPS on throughput and SLO compliance, but DPS still gains 1–3 pp effective pass@1 on GLM (from time spent in full-quality mode at low and moderate rates) at a small TPOT cost. No single static configuration wins across regimes: Static FP8 wins TPOT at the cost of permanent accuracy loss, Static FP16 wins TPOT at low load but collapses under bursts, and DPS wins on effective pass@1 across the entire range.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 在三种运行模式下，都呈现出一个一致的趋势。 在低负载下，DPS 因 SUM 记账和 FP16 重建而承受几毫秒的 TPOT 开销，以及最多 25 毫秒的 TTFT 开销。 一旦 KV 压力显现，DPS 的持续吞吐量会提升 2.1–3.3 × \times，TTFT 相比静态 FP16 提升两个数量级，且有效 pass@1 表现更优。 在 KV 压力下，DPS 的弹性 KV 容量能减少抢占，使其能够维持更大的活跃批处理规模，并分摊每一步的权重读取开销；而静态 FP16 的固定预算则无法容纳完整批处理。 静态 FP8 是唯一在吞吐量和 SLO 合规性上能与 DPS 匹敌的基线方案，但 DPS 在 GLM 上仍能以较小的 TPOT 代价，获得 1–3 pp 的有效 pass@1 提升（这得益于其在低到中速率下运行于全质量模式所花费的时间）。 没有任何一种静态配置能在所有运行模式下胜出：静态 FP8 以永久损失精度为代价获得了更低的 TPOT；静态 FP16 在低负载下表现优于 TPOT，但在突发负载下会崩溃；而 DPS 则在整个范围内都实现了更高的有效 pass@1。

paragraphs.en: Table II summarizes mode-switching activity under the bursty traces of Section V-B2 . DPS spends 100% of serving time in full-quality mode on Phi-3.5-MoE (no KV pressure, no transitions), matching the no-overhead behavior in Figure 6 (a). On Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM-4.7-Flash, only two full → \to perf and two perf → \to full transitions occur across the entire trace, showing that the threshold-with-hysteresis policy (Section IV-D ) consolidates bursts into a few long mode-windows rather than flapping rapidly. The reverse transition dominates the cost: average end-to-end restore latency is 8.5 s on GLM and 24.7 s on Qwen, set by the H2D transfer of 14/40 and 40/40 residual units from pinned CPU memory at near-identical per-unit cost (607 vs. 616 ms/unit) — restoration thus scales linearly with evicted units rather than total model size, and GLM’s lower total reflects only its lighter peak pressure. Because this transfer runs on the background restore worker and overlaps with ongoing decode, it does not block requests; its only runtime cost is bounded PCIe contention, and the user-visible impact remains negligible (Section V-B2 ).

paragraphs.en: LLM Serving Systems with Virtual Memory. One fundamental feature of DPS is to preserve paged KV cache management in modern LLM-serving systems, such as in vLLM [ 9 , 10 ] . Some recent approaches, such as [ 55 , 54 ] , also leverage dynamic memory management when serving multiple LLM models. [ 55 ] primarily targets memory sharing across different vLLM engines, while [ 54 ] focuses on serving with a quantized model and an FP16 model.
paragraphs.zh: 具有虚拟内存的大型语言模型服务系统。 DPS 的一个基本特性是在现代大型语言模型服务系统（例如 vLLM [9, 10]）中保留分页 KV 缓存管理。 一些近期的方法，例如 [55, 54]，在部署多个大型语言模型时也利用了动态内存管理。 [55] 主要关注不同 vLLM 引擎之间的内存共享，而 [54] 则专注于同时部署量化模型和 FP16 模型。

paragraphs.en: Model Offloading. DPS performs offloading of partial model state from CPU to GPU during full-quality-mode restoration. There are many recent offloading techniques, such as those in [ 56 , 57 , 54 ] , for addressing GPU memory constraints in LLM serving systems. A common concept is to hide host-to-device memory transfers during GPU computation. For example, [ 56 ] executes a layer in batches, providing sufficient GPU computation time to hide model transfers. [ 54 ] assumes that model transfers can be hidden by GPU computation.
paragraphs.zh: 模型卸载。 在全质量模式恢复期间，DPS 会将部分模型状态从 CPU 卸载到 GPU。 近期出现了许多卸载技术，例如 [56, 57, 54] 中提出的方法，用于解决 LLM 服务系统中的 GPU 内存限制问题。 一个常见的思路是在 GPU 计算期间隐藏主机到设备的内存传输。 例如，[56] 按批次执行一层，从而为模型传输提供足够的 GPU 计算时间以实现隐藏。 [54] 假设模型传输可以通过 GPU 计算被隐藏。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and Future Work. Page-based KV memory management may incur memory fragmentation [ 58 , 59 ] . Meanwhile, the nested FP8-FP16 model is a specific case of dynamic networks. Investigating KV cache fragmentation or extending the method to various dynamic networks are promising future directions for DPS with SUM. Additionally, DPS focuses mainly on a coarse-grained nested model, as our target is to immediately expand a page-based KV cache as in vLLM. This design can be extended to layer-wise weight tensors, as in some recent layer-wise mixed-precision approaches [ 54 , 60 ] , which can greatly extend the flexibility of DPS. We treat this integration as promising future work.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 基于页面的 KV 内存管理可能会导致内存碎片化 [ 58 , 59 ] 。 同时，嵌套的 FP8-FP16 模型是动态网络的一个特例。 研究 KV 缓存碎片化问题，或将该方法扩展到各种动态网络，都是 DPS 结合 SUM 的有前景的未来方向。 此外，DPS 主要关注粗粒度的嵌套模型，因为我们的目标是像 vLLM 那样立即扩展基于页面的 KV 缓存。 这种设计可以扩展到逐层的权重张量，就像一些近期的逐层混合精度方法 [ 54 , 60 ] 一样，这能极大地提升 DPS 的灵活性。 我们将这种整合视为一项有前景的未来工作。

paragraphs.en: This paper introduces an effective dual-precision serving with semi-unified memory. The proposed scheme is built on two fundamental concepts: (1) SUM to effectively mitigate KV cache pressure and possibly reduce preemptions, and (2) dual-precision serving with asymmetric switching based on nested models. With SUM, it turns weight memory into an elastic resource: under normal load, DPS serves the higher-precision model; under KV pressure, it switches to a nested, lower-precision variant and repurposes unused weight memory for KV cache blocks. DPS can serve as an extension for existing LLM serving systems, such as vLLM [ 10 ] while maintaining the effective dynamic structure of KV cache management.
paragraphs.zh: 本文介绍了一种采用半统一内存的有效双精度服务方案。 所提出的方案基于两个核心概念：（1）SUM，用于有效缓解 KV 缓存压力并可能减少抢占；以及（2）基于嵌套模型的非对称切换双精度服务。 通过 SUM，权重内存可转化为弹性资源：在正常负载下，DPS 使用更高精度的模型提供服务；当 KV 缓存压力增大时，则切换到嵌套的更低精度变体，并将未使用的权重内存重新用于 KV 缓存块。 DPS 可作为现有 LLM 服务系统（如 vLLM [10]）的扩展，同时保持 KV 缓存管理的有效动态结构。
